question: Which Ezh2-associated changes in the original DuPage Tregs warrant a specific identity, survival or suppressive-function follow-up?
decision: Create a bounded, literature-triaged target candidate set without requiring the Zhang tumor/NK direction or claiming target validation.
strongest_rival: Different bulk mixtures or selective survival within the Foxp3-positive gate, plus technical preparation variability, can mimic state-dependent regulation.
discriminator: Two signed tracks retain robust low-state changes and state-prioritized changes separately; literature and future protein/function perturbation distinguish mechanistic candidates from state or selection markers.
exposure_record: S0-S3 and published outcomes are exposed. Il2, Ctla4, Il2ra, Il10 and Tgfb1 rows were viewed during Zhang/Wang reading before the owner requested a DuPage-first screen. Original-paper Pde3b/Tcf7/Lef1 examples and a 2024 TCF7/LEF1 precedent are known. No new ranking or additional sensitivity minima calculated before this freeze.
biological_unit: Source biological preparation; individual mouse, pool membership and cross-state pairing remain unknown. This stage counts files/features, not animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve libraries from one study; GSM1423627 excluded by authors. All reuse of these libraries is shared-source reanalysis. Replicate labels do not prove pairing or independence.
population_and_selection: Female C57BL/6 healthy mosaic mice; spleen/LN sorted Foxp3-positive CD4+CD25+YFP+RFP+ Tregs, conditional Ezh2 HET or KO, observed CD62L high/low.
contrast: (mean log2(FPKM+1) KO_low - HET_low) - (KO_high - HET_high); observed states, not a temporal intervention.
endpoint: Per-gene low-state KO-HET contrast and state interaction; sign-oriented minima across declared sensitivities, complete orderings and a bounded reading frontier.
methods: Exactly TARGET_SCREEN_PLAN_V1.md: fixed 11614 loci and 11 libraries; primary log2(FPKM+1), 11 separate omissions, full-sample pseudocount 0.5/2. Low track requires stable low sign; state track additionally stable coherent interaction sign and larger primary absolute low than high contrast. Order by sign-oriented minimum of low or interaction respectively; first 10 per signed track for reading only. Preserve all rows and 19 named anchors separately. S3 chromatin is annotation only.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain S1 universe, all-OK filtering and source exclusion. Never reintroduce excluded low-depth GSM1423627. No outlier deletion or post-outcome rethresholding.
multiplicity: No tests, FDR or probability of target validity. All loci retained; top 10 per signed track is a finite reading budget, not an effect threshold.
precision_basis: Observed sample variation and PCA only; no confidence intervals because mouse/pool identity and independence are not qualified.
interpretation_limit: Post-outcome exploratory RNA selection from surviving Foxp3-positive preparations. Sensitivity stability cannot establish biological independence, direct Ezh2 regulation, protein expression, cell function, novelty or target validity.
stop_rule: Stop on universe or symbol-join mismatch, nonfinite values or unreconciled S1/S2 contrasts. Retain empty/fragile/biologically unsupported outcomes; do not change ranking after seeing candidates.
amendment_reason: New owner-requested DuPage-first exploration after the completed S0-S6 reconstruction. Adds target selection and low-contrast sensitivity; does not supersede frozen results.
